artworks.title: Impressions de voyage d'un grand poete
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene in front of a butcher shop. The image depicts a figure balancing a large cut of meat on its shoulder. To the right, there are hanging meats displayed prominently. Two figures stand in conversation near the shop entrance. A dog is running in the foreground. The ground has swirling lines. The style conveys a lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: Les Journaux bienfaisans
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene with two men in conversation. One man is gesturing animatedly while the other listens attentively. In the background is a large cabinet filled with various objects, including a parrot, a taxidermied animal, books, and glass displays. Beside the men is a window with the word 'CAISSE' on it. This painting is done in the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Dites donc, mame Giboulard...
artworks.description: Two elderly women in hooded shawls and dresses mop the street. They have weathered faces, with one woman wearing a tighter hood and the other with a broader nose and open mouth. They hold mop handles on wet ground with puddles. In the background, there are people and building facades suggesting a busy urban street scene.

artworks.title: L'Entrée dans la vie
artworks.description: The image shows three adults and a baby. Two women and a man are seated in the background, while another man is standing in the foreground. The man on the right is holding an unclothed baby. The man on the left is standing in less formal attire. Behind them, two women are sitting draped in cloaks. The background features a draped curtain and a framed picture or mirror on the wall.

artworks.title: Un Voyage d'agrément a Paris
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of men in a street setting. Central figure standing with arms slightly extended, holding papers. Other men surround him, all dressed in long coats and hats. Background shows a carriage wheel and outlines of a building with partial text. Crowd extends into the distance, creating a busy street scene.

artworks.title: Vois-tu, mon ami... il n'y a que deux élemens... du bonheur...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three individuals gathered around a table under a leafy canopy. Two individuals are seated at a wooden table, while a third stands beside them. The seated individuals have varied poses, one leaning forward attentively and the other wearing a hat with a striped pattern. The backdrop is dense with foliage creating a textured, intricate contrast to the white space around them. The style is sketch-like with emphasis on shading and line work, displaying the figures and greenery.

artworks.title: Une Révolte a bord
artworks.description: This is a drawing of individuals in a boat named "Le Bas Billon". The scene depicts a small rowboat on a water body, with one person in a top hat standing on the boat holding an oar and observing two other individuals in the boat. The figures are rendered with detailed expressions. The background features a calm horizon line with sparse indications of distant land or figures. The boat's name is prominently displayed on its side. The use of shading and line work emphasizes the drama and movement within the scene.

artworks.title: Ah! ben... le convoi... peut se flatter de l'échapper...
artworks.description: Two men are separated by a wooden fence. The man on the left is wearing a dark suit with a long coat and a top hat. He is leaning over the fence and looking at the man on the right. The man on the right is kneeling on one knee, holding a stick or thin object and wearing a loose-fitting outfit with stripes on the lower leg. He has a full beard and a broad-brimmed hat with the letters "M.L.B." The background shows a sketched, rocky landscape or large hill beyond the fence.

artworks.title: Allons donc... que diable cocher...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse-drawn carriage traveling quickly. It shows the front view of the carriage being pulled by a horse. The open-topped carriage contains four figures. The horse is detailed, and its posture suggests movement. In the background, there is an explosion with curved lines indicating motion and a chaotic scene. The drawing is in black and white, emphasizing contrast and shadow.

artworks.title: La Rencontre sous bois
artworks.description: The image shows two men in a wooded setting, both engaged in an encounter or confrontation. The point of view is level with the two men. A large tree dominates the center, obscuring part of each man. The horizon is not clearly visible due to dense foliage. The style of the artwork is detailed with fine brushstrokes, characterized by cross-hatching and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black, white, and gray. One man stands holding a stick, crouched as if ready to spring. Across from him, the other man leans forward with a weapon in hand. Beyond them, more trees fade into the dark tones of the woods.

artworks.title: Un Amant trop heureux
artworks.description: The image features two individuals in an interior setting. The person on the left has their back to the viewer, leaning forward into a doorway with one arm slightly bent. They have dark, medium-length hair and are dressed in a textured garment. To the right, a man is standing upright with shoulders back. He is shown in profile, with defined facial features including a prominent nose, thin mustache, and receding hairline. The man is dressed in a dark, patterned coat and appears to be holding a cane or stick. The background is sketched with lines indicating depth and shading, emphasizing the opening between the two figures.

artworks.title: Une Demande en séparation
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals from the waist up. The figure in the foreground is seated with hands clasped, wearing glasses and a suit. The person behind them has arms raised and a more intense expression. They wear a robe-like garment. In the background, there is an open book on a table and a top hat on its side. The background is sketched with a simple texture.

artworks.title: Devant M. le Maire
artworks.description: The image shows three people from the waist up. On the left, a man stands upright, looking slightly to the right. He has short, neatly combed hair and distinct facial features, dressed in a dark suit and a white shirt with a high collar. In the center, a woman with her head tilted downwards wears a bonnet adorned with ribbons and a large bow under her chin, along with a dark cloak. Her face is partly obscured by the bonnet's brim. On the right, another man with a receding hairline and spectacles is shown leaning slightly forward while holding an open book. He wears a similar dark suit and white shirt as the man on the left. All three stand before a table on which lie papers and an inkwell. The background is a simple crosshatched pattern.

artworks.title: Une Maitresse a l'Opéra
artworks.description: This image shows two men from the waist up, positioned next to each other in what appears to be a conversation. They are depicted in a detailed sketch style. The man on the left has short, slicked-back hair and is shown in profile view, while the man on the right has a slightly receding hairline and wavy hair, and is smiling with a more forward-facing orientation. Both men are dressed in formal attire; they are wearing dark coats with light-colored waistcoats underneath, and white shirts with high collars. The man on the right holds a small rectangular object in his right hand. In the background, there are sketches of other people and an audience in a venue setting. The page exhibits signs of foxing, with brown spots scattered across the surface.

artworks.title: Les Fumeurs de Hadchids
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated close together, displaying their upper bodies. Both men are leaning back in chairs. One man is holding a long pipe emitting smoke. The man on the left has long hair combed back, distinct facial features, and is wearing a suit with a high-collared shirt. The man on the right has dark, wavy hair, an upturned nose, and is dressed in a suit with a vest and shirt. The setting seems to be a simple indoor environment with a textured background, focusing on the subjects in the foreground.

artworks.title: Un Vainqueur de Steeple-chase
artworks.description: The image displays the upper half of two men who are positioned closely side by side. The man on the left has a side profile, showing his eyes closed or looking down, with a beard and short hair partially covered by a cap with a visor. He is wearing a shirt that has a loose, open collar with a sash draped over one shoulder. The man on the right is depicted with a surprised or wide-eyed expression, having prominent eyes and a mustache, with curly hair peeking from beneath a tall top hat. He is dressed in a suit with a neck scarf and is holding a stick or cane. The background is a plain, sketched setting, with some lines suggesting movement or a simplistic environment with no detailed scenery.

artworks.title: Le Format de plus en plus monstre
artworks.description: The image features two people indoors, with their upper bodies visible. The person on the left is seated in profile, wearing glasses and a fez-like hat, while holding a newspaper. The person on the right is also seated, wearing a bonnet or headscarf, with a collared garment. The background shows wallpaper with a swirling pattern and a framed picture hanging on the wall.

artworks.title: Un Chapeau Pamèla
artworks.description: The image shows two women depicted from the waist up. The woman on the left wears a dark dress with light, patterned sections at the cuffs and frills around her shoulders. She holds a handkerchief in one hand and her other hand rests near her chin. Her head is covered with a bonnet and a large ribbon or flower is attached to the side of the bonnet. The woman on the right has her hair neatly styled back and wears a simple dress with a fitted bodice and long sleeves. She has her hands clasped together near her chest, with wide eyes and slightly parted lips. The background shows a textured, patterned wall implying an indoor setting, with part of a sculpted piece of furniture visible on the right.

artworks.title: Les Crêpes
artworks.description: The image depicts four people. The main focus is a person standing in the foreground with a towel wrapped around their head, holding a kitchen ladle. Surrounding this person are three others, one with distinct cheekbones and earrings, another with long hair, and the third peeking out from behind the central figure. In the background, there is a table with three bottles and an empty plate. The drawing is done in a sketchy, monochromatic style with heavy contrast and shading.

artworks.title: Une Visite du 1er Janvier
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper halves of two men facing each other in profile. The man on the left has short, receding hair and a thin face, looking somber. The man on the right has messy hair and a scruffy beard, appearing engaged. They wear period clothing, with the man on the left in a suit and the man on the right in a loose garment. The background has a textured, shaded pattern. There is a handwritten note at the bottom and the artist's signature at the top.

artworks.title: Réception d'un franc-maçon
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the waist up, in a confrontational stance. The man on the left holds a sharp object pointed towards the man on the right. The man on the left has receding hair and a determined or angry expression. He wears a dark coat and a high-collared shirt with a patterned cover draped over his shoulder. The man on the right appears startled or concerned, with messy hair and prominent eyebrows. He wears a similar dark outfit with a high-collared shirt. There is no visible jewelry on either man. The background has cross-hatching and shading.

artworks.title: Un Père heureux
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals: an adult male, an adult female, and a baby within a cradle. The male adjusts spectacles on his face, with a furrowed brow and short, slightly messy hair. He wears a dark, double-breasted jacket. The female, partially visible from the chest up, stands beside him, looking towards the cradle. She wears a headscarf and a shawl. The baby lies in a wicker cradle covered with a blanket and wears a patterned cap. The background is a simple, shaded oval with no discernable details.

artworks.title: Une Nouvelle connaissance
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals in a half-body format. On the left, a man is leaning slightly forward, while a woman stands facing him on the right. The man has a bald head with a few tufts of hair, a prominent nose, and is wearing a dark suit. His hand is in his jacket pocket. The woman has a round face with lines on her forehead, wears a broad-brimmed bonnet tied under her chin, and carries a small dog wrapped in a blanket. The background is textured and dark, creating an old-fashioned feel.

artworks.title: Un Retour de jeunesse
artworks.description: The image shows two people, depicted from approximately the waist up. On the left, there is an older man facing slightly toward the woman beside him. He has a pronounced nose, a prominent forehead, and short, curly gray hair. He is dressed in a dark jacket over a lighter-colored shirt or vest, holding a top hat. The woman on the right is wearing a bonnet and a light-patterned shawl with intricate designs. She has heavy eyelids and a slightly upturned nose, holding a small object in her hand. The background contains shaded, indistinct figures and features, in shades of black and gray.
